title: ee.daemon.request.v1
description: Length-prefixed JSON request envelope for the optional `ee daemon` Unix-domain socket RPC introduced by bd-oja31 (SRR1 hot-mode skeleton). Wire framing: 4-byte big-endian unsigned length, then exactly that many bytes of UTF-8 JSON conforming to this schema. The daemon process binds the socket at `${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/ee/daemon.sock` on Linux and `/tmp/ee-daemon.sock` on macOS (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is not standard on Darwin). The daemon is opt-in; every CLI command continues to work when the socket is absent. The skeleton shipped under this schema covers the two seed methods — `ee.daemon.echo` (round-trip integrity check) and `ee.daemon.context` (degraded stub that surfaces `daemon_ann_warmload_not_yet_implemented` until the ANN warm-load slice lands). Requests carry `agent_id` and optional `workspace_id` so future warm-load, audit, and authorization slices do not have to break the v1 envelope to attribute calls.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen identifier echoed in the matching response. Recommended shape: ULID or UUIDv7. The daemon does not assign request ids; missing or non-matching ids in responses indicate a framing bug or a redirected connection.

agent_id.description: Caller-chosen local agent identity echoed in the matching response. This is an attribution/audit field reserved by bd-1clej; authorization policy remains a follow-up and MUST NOT be inferred from the field alone.

workspace_id.description: Optional caller workspace identity echoed in the matching response when present. This reserves the envelope slot for future workspace-scoped warm-load and audit logic without changing the daemon v1 wire shape later.

method.description: Method dispatch name. `ee.daemon.echo` returns the supplied params unchanged for round-trip integrity checks. `ee.daemon.context` is the warm-loaded `ee context` path stub; today it returns `error.code = daemon_ann_warmload_not_yet_implemented` with severity `medium` until the ANN warm-load slice (bd-17c65.14.9 follow-up) ships.

params.description: Method-specific parameters. For `ee.daemon.echo` this is an arbitrary JSON object that will be returned unchanged. For `ee.daemon.context` this carries the same shape as `ee context --json` request (workspace, task, max_tokens, profile); the stub does NOT validate the shape and returns `daemon_ann_warmload_not_yet_implemented` immediately regardless of contents.
